name: Faraway Galaxy
description:
About This Game

Faraway Galaxy is a new tactical roguelite deckbuilder set in a bizarre galaxy and wrapped as a tabletop game. It's hosted by a charismatic narrator – a battle-hardened space wolf will be your Dungeon Master: dealing cards, rolling dice, voicing alien pirates, and offering dark sarcastic commentary on your choices. Expect short but intense puzzle-like battles, powerful artifact collecting, and tough decisions in unexpected FTL-style events.

Key Features:

  • The Force is with you: forget the classic split between health and mana since “Force” combines your health, base damage, and energy for playing cards. Powerful moves leave you more vulnerable, and killing enemies is your main way to instantly recover and keep the combo going.

  • Upgrade yourself and your enemies: deckbuilding happens on the go with no tedious card management breaks. After every victory you pick a new card for your hand… but you must also choose an upgrade card for your enemies. Your opponents evolve and adapt alongside you!

  • Bite-sized tactical encounters: every fight is an exciting little puzzle where you always stand solo against coordinated squads of enemies. Chain status effects, play power-up cards, and ride the luck of the dice.

  • Five unique factions with numerous professions: face the collective mind of the Omicronians, furious Blobs, cunning Reptiloids, relentless Droids, and Humans. Each race can be combined with a wide range of professions, creating limitless combat scenarios.

  • Every boss makes you stronger: defeat unique enemies, claim their artifacts, and unlock secret characters with their own starter decks and dialogue perks. Collect the full set of relics to become the greatest hero of the galaxy!
short_desc: Faraway Galaxy is a new roguelite deckbuilder framed as a bizarre tabletop adventure narrated by a battle-hardened space wolf. Master intense tactical battles and meaningful choices between them. Fight alien pirates, collect artifacts, and uncover new encounters!
